violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. OBSERVED NO CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER ONSITE AT THE BEGINNING OF THE INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CFM ARRIVED DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE MORE STAFF RECEIVE A CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER CERTIFICATION AS SOON AS POSSIBLE AND ENSURE A CFM IS ONSITE DURING ALL HOURS OF OPERATION.

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee failed to wash his or her hands before engaging in food preparation, after touching bare human body parts, after coughing, sneezing, eating, after handling soiled utensils, or after engaging in any activity that could contaminate the hands. OBSERVED NO EMPLOYEES WASH HANDS DURING THE INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. EHS DISCUSSED HANDWASHING REQUIREMENTS WITH THE PIC. PLEASE ENSURE HANDWASHING PROCEDURES ARE REVIEWED WITH ALL STAFF AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: NO PAPER TOWELS OBSERVED AT ALL THREE HANDWASHING SINKS IN THE KITCHEN/FRONT BAR AREA AT BEGINNING OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC ADDED PAPER TOWELS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE HANDWASHING SINKS ARE ALWAYS PROPERLY SUPPLIED.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: RAW LAMB STORED OVER COOKED BEEF IN THE WALK-IN COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC REORGANIZED COOLER DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED COOKED STEAK AT 55F, YOGURT AT 55F, YOGURT #2 AT 56F, RAW LAMB AT 46-55F, AND RAW CHICKEN AT 50-54F IN THE 3-DOOR PREP-TOP. OBSERVED HUMMUS AT 44F IN THE WALK-IN COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED OF FOODS DURING INSPECTION. PIC UNDERSTANDS ALL COLD HOLDING FOODS SHOULD BE KEPT AT 41F OR BELOW. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Cannot Exceed 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item for which time rather than temperature is being used as a control was not cooked, served or discarded by the expiration time as indicated: OBSERVED GYRO ON TIME THAT WAS PUT OUT ON THE SPIT APPROXIMATELY 4.5-5 HOURS PRIOR.
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours is used as the public health control : 1) the food shall have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature or, 2) the food shall have an initial temperature of 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 3) the food shall be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 4) the food shall be cooked and served, served if ready to eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 5) the food if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit shall be discarded. EHS REVIEWED TIME AS A PUBLIC HEALTH CONTROL REQUIREMENTS WITH THE PIC. PIC DISCARDED OF THE GYRO DURING THE INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION AND PROPER 4- HOUR MARKING IS ASSOCIATED WITH THE GYRO (OR A TIMER) BY THE TIME OF THE FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Restricted Use Pesticide, Conditions of use
violations.observation: Restricted, commercial use pesticides present in the facility are applied by the operator who is not a certified pesticide applicator. OBSERVED 5 DIFFERENT SPRAY CANS OF PEST CONTROL THROUGHOUT THE BACK KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Because of their toxicity, restricted use pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. EHS DISCUSSED PEST CONTROL REQUIREMENTS WITH THE PIC. PIC DISCARDED OF PEST CONTROL SPRAYS DURING INSPECTION AND UNDERSTANDS PEST CONTROL TREATMENTS MUST BE DONE BY A CERTIFIED PEST CONTROL APPLICATOR IN THE FUTURE. PIC HAS BEEN IN CONTACT WITH A PEST CONTROL COMPANY TO START A CONTRACT.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: OBSERVED THE THREE-DOOR PREP-TOP AT 48F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC DISCARDED OF TCS FOODS IN THE COOLER DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE THIS COOLER HAS BEEN REPAIRED BY THE TIME OF THE FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: OBSERVED INTERIOR OF THE THREE-DOOR PREP-TOP AT THE TWO-DOOR UPRIGHT FREEZER IN NEED OF CLEANING DUE TO ACCUMULATION OF FOOD DEBRIS.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. PLEASE THOROUGHLY CLEAN THESE UNITS AS SOON AS POSSIBLE AND PRIOR TO THE FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink. OBSERVED BOTH HANDWASHING SINKS IN THE KITCHEN WITHOUT PAPER TOWELS.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC ADDED PAPER TOWELS TO SINKS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE SINKS ARE ALWAYS PROPERLY SUPPLIED.

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: OBSERVED FRONT HANDWASHING SINK WITH CONTAINER/BOTTLE IN SINK BASIN. OBSERVED FOOD DEBRIS IN THE BACK HANDWASHING SINK BASIN.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. EHS DISCUSSED PROPER SINK USAGE WITH PIC. PLEASE ENSURE STAFF UNDERSTAND HANDWASHING SINKS ARE FOR HANDWASHING ONLY AND SHOULD ALWAYS BE ACCESSIBLE. ANATOLIAN BISTRO (Inspection Date: 02/12/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED GYRO ON THE SPIT AT 73F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC DISCARDED GYRO MEAT BY 3:00PM. PIC UNDERSTANDS GYRO SHALL BE ON TIME CONTROL OR PIECES MUST BE SHAVED OFF AND COOLED TO 41F OR BELOW WITHIN 4 HOURS. MORE GUIDANCE WILL BE PROVIDED TO THE PIC. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: OBSERVED SOME FOOD ITEMS IN THE WALK-IN COOLER WITHOUT A DATE MARKING.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. PIC ADDED DATE MARKINGS DURING INSPECTION AND UNDERSTANDS THAT FOOD ITEMS PREPARED OR COOKED AND KEPT FOR MORE THAN 24 HOURS NEED TO HAVE A DATE MARKING. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Proper Thawing Methods for ROP Fish
violations.observation: OBSERVED COMMERCIALLY VACUUM PACKAGED SALMON IN THE WALK-IN COOLER IN INTACT PACKAGING.
violations.corrective_action: EHS PROVIDED PROPER THAWING GUIDANCE FOR ROP FISH. PIC REMOVED FISH FROM PACKAGING DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: OBSERVED VARIOUS FOODS IN BOTTLES/CONTAINERS WITHOUT A PROPER LABEL.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. PIC UNDERSTANDS ALL FOOD ITEMS NOT IN ITS ORIGINAL CONTAINER SHOULD HAVE A LABEL.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: OBSERVED RICE SCOOP IN AMBIENT TEMPERATURE WATER; OBSERVED CUPS WITHOUT HANDLES IN VARIOUS FOOD ITEMS.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EHS DISCUSSED PROPER UTENSIL STORAGE WITH PIC. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Design/Install per Law
violations.observation: The plumbing system serving this food service facility has not been designed, constructed, and installed according to the Plumbing Code. THREE-VAT SINK PLUMBING CONFIGURATION IS NOT AIR GAPPED PROPERLY.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be designed, constructed, and installed according to Law. EHS HAD PROVIDED PIC WITH ACCEPTED CONFIGURATIONS AT TIME OF CHANGE OF OWNERSHIP INSPECTION. PIC CONTACTED PLUMBER DURING INSPECTION. PIC UNDERSTANDS PROOF OF CORRECTION NEEDS TO BE PROVIDED TO EHS BY FEBRUARY 22ND.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: OBSERVED FLOORS/WALLS IN NEED OF CLEANING, ESPECIALLY AROUND COOK-LINE AND THREE-VAT SINK AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. PIC UNDERSTANDS CLEANING FREQUENCY SHOULD IMPROVE TO PREVENT GRIME ACCUMULATION.
